archetypes.name: waterfall-parity
archetypes.rationale: Waterfall semantics are parity-sensitive across phase ordering and gate behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Python dispatcher against the retired Bash contract. Focus on phase launch/collect ordering, fallback queue construction, pattern-gate behavior, dropped-slot diagnostics, and emitted KV/path-file compatibility. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-cutover
archetypes.rationale: Multiple shell, Python, and embedded-asset callers now invoke the new verb.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check every caller cutover for argv-array safety, preserved environment override seams, and stdout/KV handling. Pay special attention to embedded plan-review assets and decompose defaults. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: teardown-safety
archetypes.rationale: The port owns process-group teardown for external agent launchers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review subprocess lifecycle handling for cancellation safety. Focus on process-group launch, SIGTERM cleanup, descendant sweep behavior, stderr sidecars, and sentinel fallback writing without leaking orphaned agents. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
